headline: Diablos Rojos del Mexico at Tigres de Quintana Roo refreshed Over 19.5 check

ranked_selections.rationale: The total remained 18 after a scoreless top of the eighth, two runs were still required, and the refreshed live market moved farther toward Under 19.5.

public_summary: Over 19.5 was still possible but clearly less likely than not at the refreshed cutoff.
